Prettier never reaches a fixed point on this input: it indents the body's FIRST line
one level on every pass (`if cond` → `\tif cond` → `\t\tif cond` → …) while every other
line keeps its authored column, so no prettier-anchored claim file
(output_prettier.svelte, audit_signature.txt, variants) is expressible. The validator
live-verifies this claim (rule F5). See README.md and
docs/conformance_prettier_svelte.md §Svelte: Elements.
